name: Lindblad Expeditions Holdings Inc.
summary:
Lindblad Expeditions (LIND) reported a loss of $0.02 per share on revenue of $199.25 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.10 per share on revenue of $185.12 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 80.00% while revenue grew 18.64% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects 2026 revenue of $830.0 million to $860.0 million. The company's previous guidance was revenue of $800.0 million to $850.0 million, and the current consensus revenue estimate is $851.05 million for the year ending December 31, 2026.

Lindblad Expeditions Holdings, Inc. is an expedition travel company that focuses on ship-based voyages through its Lindblad Expeditions brand and on land-based travel through its subsidiary, Natural Habitat Adventures, an adventure travel and ecotourism company with a focus on responsible nature travel.
subject: Lindblad Expeditions Beat Consensus Estimates
